test: two-sided one-sample Wilcoxon signed-rank test against the study-specific zero reference; Benjamini-Hochberg correction across 20 candidates
interpretation_boundary: The zero reference is study specific and is not an adjacent-normal comparison.
candidate_selection: Fixed outcome-blind LUAD top 20 ranked by the historically locked DCPI-RWR bias-aware configuration among genes without Open Targets 26.06 clinical-stage evidence; CPTAC outcomes were not used to tune, filter, or reorder candidates.
